# Eric Meyer — Reset Styles (2007-04-12)

- Author: Eric A. Meyer.
- Source: [Reset Styles, published April 12, 2007](https://meyerweb.com/eric/thoughts/2007/04/12/reset-styles/).
- License: public domain; the author [confirms this applies from first publication](https://meyerweb.com/eric/thoughts/2011/01/26/reset-v2-0/).
- `reset.css` contains the first CSS code block from that post, with HTML entities decoded, CRLF line endings converted to LF, and surrounding blank lines removed. A final newline is retained; selectors and declarations are unchanged.
- SHA-256 of `reset.css`: `5131864e090796b73d1da40affbd3ce26f5fb615dcd1ae29b2a23daa8722cd4c`.
